This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 01/07/2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Crestview Supplies LLC, with its registered office at 88 Commerce Drive,
Cleveland ("Party A"), and Harborline Foods Corp, with its registered office at 1200 Industrial
Parkway, Springfield ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Signatures

Party A   Crestview Supplies LLC / John Carter
Party B   Harborline Foods Corp / Maria Lopez
